tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: The meeting was postponed until next month.
I have a good relationship with my neighbours.
She immediately started crying when she heard the news.
items.transformed: She _________ when she heard the news.

items.original: People do not realise how difficult the exam is.
items.transformed: Little _________ how difficult the exam is.

items.original: As soon as we sat down, the film started.
items.transformed: No _________ down than the film started.

items.original: Everyone came to the party except Tom.
items.transformed: Everyone _________ Tom came to the party.

items.original: Your advice gave me a lot to think about.
items.transformed: Your advice gave me plenty of _________.
